reviews.quote: Delicious food, amazing service and excellent setting. The atmosphere is very enjoyable.
reviews.author: Ivan O.

reviews.quote: No wonder this restaurant is rated so highly. Dropped in for lunch and WOW! Food was outstanding.
reviews.author: Andrew M.

reviews.quote: Bún bò Huế here is the best in Perth! The broth is rich, flavourful, and tastes just like the real thing.
reviews.author: Phuong M.

reviews.quote: Prices are fair and worth your money. The food is fresh and full of flavor.
reviews.author: Sai V.

reviews.quote: Was lovely and the staff were so lovely too. Recommend the rare beef pho and the coffee!
reviews.author: Clare M.

reviews.quote: Super delicious and definitely a future regular. Service team were so polite.
reviews.author: Dev K.

reviews.quote: The flavours are bold, authentic, and confidently executed, with each dish clearly prepared with care and attention to detail.
reviews.author: Felix C.
